title: Power Rankings: Suns, Thunder making moves
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 15
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: The Cavs are three W's away from the longest win streak in team history, on pace to win 65 games again and you can't even knock Mike Brown's offense any more. Our clear-cut No. 1s are fifth in offensive efficiency.
